pretreatments.description: Ozone pretreatment performed at 5.3% ozone concentration (w/w) for 10 minutes using a Pacific Ozone generator, operating in a semi-continuous mode with 0.79 g O_3/g TS.

Soaking aqueous ammonia (SAA) pretreatment using 28–30% (w/w) ammonium hydroxide solution at 50 °C for 24 hours with a solid-to-liquid ratio of 2:10, followed by washing with distilled water and drying at 50 °C.
Ozone combined with SAA (OSAA) pretreatment, where ozone pretreatment (0.79 g O_3/g TS for 10 minutes) was followed by SAA pretreatment (28–30% ammonium hydroxide at 50 °C for 6 hours).
Size reduction treatment using a hammer mill to reduce grass particle size to less than 1 mm, followed by sieving to a size range of 0.354–0.5 mm for experiments.

Mechanical grinding/drying process: The raw grass clippings were collected, dried at 60 °C for 24 hours, and then ground to a particle size of less than 1 mm in a hammer mill before being sieved for experimentation.
